test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question: With which of the following nations did India ink a landmark ‘Defense Pact’ in June 2020 to access each other's bases?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Australi__a.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the** Defence Pact, India and Australia's defence ministers** will conduct a comprehensive assessment of strategic issues and the regional security matrix in June 2020.
 
• They shared the goal of creating a**n open, inclusive, and rules-based Indo-Pacific, **a region that has seen increasing Chinese aggression.
 
• **Defence Minister Rajnath Singh and his Australian colleague Richard Marles** discussed industrial collaboration in the defence manufacturing industry as well as strategies to improve their military capabilities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Regular** personnel and training exchanges,** such as short specialised courses and longer-term jobs, strengthen ties between Australia and India's defence services.
 
• The Australian and Indian forces have become more interoperable as the number of common platforms has grown, providing potential for collaborative training.
 
• **C-17** strategic transport is one of them.
